{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Heavy wool overcoat, structured fit, knee-length hem, charcoal gray (#2F3336), dense melton fabric.
Crew-neck turtleneck sweater, slim silhouette, hip-length cut, crisp white (#FFFFFF), fine merino knit.
Straight-leg dark denim jeans, relaxed waistband, mid-calf length, deep navy indigo (#1A2B42), durable cotton twill.
Chunky leather ankle boots, square toe, calf-high shaft, matte black (#1C1C1C), oil-resistent rubber sole.
This ensemble respects the strict business dress code while providing essential thermal protection against frost and snow. The heavy wool coat acts as a functional outer layer for the −10 °C temperatures, ensuring warmth during your twenty-minute walk on salted roads. By keeping the base layers in dark denim and a neutral turtleneck, the outfit maintains a polished, professional appearance suitable for a corporate meeting without feeling bulky or restrictive."}
